title: Würth Group
content:
Overview:
The Würth Group is leading in the development, production, and sale of assembly and fastening materials. Other trading and production companies, the Allied Companies, operate in related business areas, ranging from electrical wholesaling and electronics to financial services. The Group currently employs more than 86,000 people in over 400 companies with more than 2,800 shops across 80 countries. The Group generated sales of EUR 20.7 billion and an operating result of EUR 970 million in the 2025 fiscal year. With over 8,000 employees, Adolf Würth GmbH & Co. KG in Künzelsau, Germany, is the largest single company in the Würth Group.

title: Würth-Group - Würth ITensis AG - - Wuerth IT Switzerland AG
content: ## Global market leader in the development. The Würth Group is the global market leader in the development, production, and sale of fastening and assembly materials. More than 400 companies operating over 2,700 branch offices and shops in 80 countries form part of this global family business, which hails from the German town of Künzelsau. The Würth Group is divided into two operational units: The Würth Line, on the one hand, specializes in the production of fastening and assembly materials for customers in the skilled trades and the industry. ## We are a family business. Behind the longstanding success of the Würth Group are people and a very special company philosophy. Würth is a family business that was founded in 1945 by Adolf Würth. Starting from the start-up years of the post-war period, he developed what was then a two-man business into a globally active trading group. "We are the employees of our customers.".

title: Adolf Würth GmbH & Co. KG -- Company History
content: **1969:** Company establishes its first business in the United States, The Würth Screw and Fastener Corporation. **1985:** Company tops sales of DM 1 billion for the first time, and sets the goal of reaching DM 10 billion (EUR 5 billion) by 2000. **1987:** Company expands into Asia with the purchase of a business in Japan and establishment of a subsidiary in Malaysia. **2000:** Würth tops EUR 5 billion in sales; now forecasts rise in sales to up to EUR 15 billion by 2010. Adolf Würth GmbH & Co. KG is the world's leading distribution group specialized in the fasteners market--that is, screws, nuts, and bolts, and other accessories--which is also the company's original product line. After nearly 60 years in business, Würth remains a privately held company owned by the founding Würth family, represented by Reinhold Würth, son of the company founder and the chief architect of its growth into one of the largest distribution companies in Germany.
